title: Normalized derivation values generate affine conormal sections
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset S$ be affine opens with $U\subset f^{-1}V$. Set $A=\Gamma(X,U)$ and $R=\Gamma(S,V)$. Let $C$ be the actual diagonal conormal [def-sc-diagonal-conormal], and let $D:\mathcal O_X\to C$ satisfy the normalization of [lem-sc-diagonal-conormal-derivation-exists]. The $A$-submodule of $\Gamma(U,C)$ generated by $\{D_U(a):a\in A\}$ is all of $\Gamma(U,C)$. No differential comparison map or injectivity is asserted.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-diagonal-conormal-affine-ideal-class] to obtain affine tensor-product coordinates r and the surjective A-linear class map q from the multiplication ideal J to actual conormal sections. The diagonal identities give U ≤ Δ⁻¹(p₁⁻¹U ∩ p₂⁻¹U).

proof.text: For a in A, put t(a)=1 ⊗ a − a ⊗ 1 in J. The class-map theorem supplies an actual kernel section s representing r(t(a)). Its projection formulas and additivity of r identify the kernel inclusion of s with p₂*(a) − p₁*(a). Apply the normalization IsDiagonalConormalDerivation to this s. Its right-hand side is the same adjunction-unit class as q(t(a)), so q(t(a))=D_U(a).

proof.text: KaehlerDifferential.submodule_span_range_eq_ideal gives span_A {t(a) in B}=J. Submodule.span_range_subtype_eq_top_iff turns this into span_A {t(a) in J}=top. The image under q of this spanning set is exactly the range of D_U by step 2. Apply Submodule.map_span and map_top; since q is surjective its range is top. Hence the values of D_U span actual conormal sections. No injectivity assertion for a differential comparison is needed.

theorem diagonalConormal_affine_derivation_span (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (D : (diagonalConormal f).val.Derivation' f.pullbackPresheafToPresheaf)
    (hD : IsDiagonalConormalDerivation f D) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, U.1) (Set.range (fun a : Γ(X, U.1) ↦
      D.d (X := op U.1) a)) = ⊤
